title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.21847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements.   We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations i

translated_title: Inventa：用于自主科学发现的去中心化自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够生成研究思路并通过迭代实验来促进科学发现。然而，增加智能体的数量或迭代次数并不必然带来更多样或更可行的想法。智能体可能会收敛到相似的候选方案，通过共享记忆组件传播缺乏依据的断言，并反复应用不再带来任何改进的搜索策略。我们提出了Inventa，一个采用自主研究单元和经验证共享知识的自动化科学发现框架。每个单元使用一个变异智能体来创建候选想法的谱系。本地编排智能体周期性地调整变异器的运行框架。当进展停滞时，编排智能体会替换其模型或重启想法演化过程。验证器评估每个候选想法，并记录经验证的改进、有用的组件和约束违规情况。
tldr: Inventa是一个去中心化的自动化科学发现框架，通过自主研究单元生成候选想法谱系、编排智能体自适应调整变异策略、以及验证器筛选并共享经验证的知识，解决了多智能体系统中想法趋同、错误信息传播和无效搜索的问题。
en_tdlr: Inventa is a decentralized automated scientific discovery framework that employs autonomous research units with mutator agents, adaptive local orchestrators, and verifiers to record verified shared knowledge, addressing idea convergence, unsupported claim propagation, and ineffective search strategies in multi-agent systems.
